source.chapter_context: Shared-book profile; Blood Angels and Deathwatch Leader targets are outside the common-book scope.
source.game_mode: Standard Warhammer 40,000 11th edition through the local match/action runtime; not full-match certification.

fixed_data_comparison.limit: Per-profile fixed-data comparison only; it does not certify equipment choices or complete datasheet behavior.

leader_targets_in_common_book_scope: Vanguard Veteran Squad With Jump Packs

scope: Exact one-model 90-point profile, 40 mm base, M12, T5, Sv3+, W5, Ld6+, OC1, 4+ invulnerable save and all nine source keywords.
All three option rows resolve to seven legal source sets; each weapon profile/mode matches extracted fields and passes Equipment and AttackPlan.
Both players materialize from current catalogs; one-to-three-copy admission succeeds and a fourth copy is rejected.
Both common-book Leader targets are checked with the 153-link relation regression; the Captain attaches to Assault Intercessors With Jump Packs.
Every model in the attached unit has Deep Strike; the public reserve choice moves the entire six-model unit into Strategic Reserves.
Angel’s Wrath adds one to the actual Advance and Charge results and does not affect an unrelated unit.
All seven loadouts equip the source-listed weapons. Relic Shield adds one Wound to its bearer and restores correctly.

Combat Doctrines, Transhuman Strategist, Strategic Acumen, Angel’s Wrath, Deep Strike, Leader and Relic Shield are registered. Strategic Acumen is owner-checked, limited to once per Command phase and expires at the next own Command phase; Warlord CP is granted once per battle round.
The paired Vanguard Veteran suite covers the second common-book bodyguard and attached reserve-cost path.

verification.command: python tools/verify.py --godot C:\Godot\4.7.2\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --profile targeted --only test_captain_with_jump_pack --only test_vanguard_veterans --only test_space_marine_leader_links --timeout 300

limits: Captain With Jump Pack shared-book local scope only. Sanguinary Guard (Blood Angels App) and Talonstrike Kill Team (Deathwatch App) are Leader targets outside the common-book 85. Full Chapter/faction and army legality, network behavior, complete-match certification and human playtesting remain outside this result; network validation is deferred to final integration.
